plans.idea: Faithful centered stack translated to square: logo masthead, big sneaker, dominant 3-line headline, one clean row of CTA + spec pills, legal footer, all on one central axis.
Headline-first poster: the launch message leads at the top, the sneaker sits large as the proof below it, the CTA/spec pill row follows, and the logo signs off bottom-left beside the legal line.
Product-led editorial: the sneaker fills the upper half as a showcase, then a left-aligned block below reads logo, headline, action pills, legal down one shared left edge.
